vision.notation: Vision-exp models document references as <image>path</image>; base64 parts are sent as OpenAI image_url parts.

notes: Thinking is a TOP-LEVEL {type:'enabled'|'disabled'} object — never 'off'. reasoning_effort is low|high|max. reasoning_content MUST be passed back on multi-turn/tool turns in thinking mode; the first streamed reasoning chunk carries an empty string and must not open a block. prompt_tokens includes cache hits.
